title: Union Membership Fell Below 10% As Private Unions Collapsed
hook: Private union membership fell to 5.9%, not the whole workforce equally.
closing: Fewer union workers means less collective leverage when pay and conditions are decided.
question: Is your job unionized?

segments.say: Union membership fell to 9.9%, less than half its earlier rate and the first single-digit reading.
Private union membership is just 5.9%, far below government workers. Private jobs drive the national decline.
Only 14.2 million workers remain union members, even as the overall workforce kept growing.
